description:
Cargo.toml workspace.dependencies declares: futures, http, reqwest, tokio-tungstenite, url. None of these are actually inherited by any crate via `{ workspace = true }`.

The single consumer of each (jmap-base-client) declares them directly with its own version pins.

Either:
1. Delete the 5 entries from workspace.dependencies (if not actually intended to be the canonical pin)
2. Convert jmap-base-client to inherit from them (preferred — but jmap-base-client is LOCKED, needs approval)

The workspace.dependencies entries today exist purely as documentation of intent that doesn't match reality.

Tied to JMAP-sc1b.X (general workspace.dependencies adoption).
title: P2: 5 workspace.dependencies entries have no consumer
